package basispoints

// Runs ONLY in the h22-live tree: records h22's own outputs for the H25 S1
// fixtures. Output path from S1_GOLDEN_OUT.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

// h22 appends one sentence per custom tool in Go map order, so with two or
// more custom tools each call returns one of several orders. Every value
// recorded below is a genuine h22 output: the one whose custom-tool sentences
// are in sorted order (retried until h22 produced it).
var s1CustomSentence = regexp.MustCompile(`Custom tool (\S+) receives`)

func s1SortedCustomOrder(text string) bool {
	names := []string{}
	for _, match := range s1CustomSentence.FindAllStringSubmatch(text, -1) {
		names = append(names, match[1])
	}
	return sort.StringsAreSorted(names)
}

func s1SortedVariant(t *testing.T, produce func() string) string {
	for i := 0; i < 2000; i++ {
		if text := produce(); s1SortedCustomOrder(text) {
			return text
		}
	}
	t.Fatal("h22 never produced the sorted custom-tool order")
	return ""
}

type s1GoldenPrompt struct {
	Body            string `json:"body"`
	PlainBody       string `json:"plain_body"`
	Instructions    string `json:"instructions"`
	PlainInstr      string `json:"plain_instructions"`
	Reminder        string `json:"reminder"`
	ReminderPresent bool   `json:"reminder_present"`
}

type s1GoldenDecode struct {
	OK   bool   `json:"ok"`
	Call string `json:"call"`
}

type s1Golden struct {
	Generator          string                    `json:"generator"`
	Prompts            map[string]s1GoldenPrompt `json:"prompts"`
	TwoCustomReminders []string                  `json:"two_custom_reminders"`
	Decodes            map[string]s1GoldenDecode `json:"decodes"`
}

func TestGenerateS1Golden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("S1_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("S1_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	golden := s1Golden{Generator: "h22-live " + Version, Prompts: map[string]s1GoldenPrompt{}, Decodes: map[string]s1GoldenDecode{}}
	for _, fixture := range s1PromptFixtures() {
		fixture := fixture
		body := s1SortedVariant(t, func() string {
			body, err := prepareResponsesBody(cloneObject(fixture.Source), defaultConfig())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
			}
			return string(jsonBytes(body))
		})
		plainBody := s1SortedVariant(t, func() string {
			plainCfg := defaultConfig()
			plainCfg.ClientIdentity.PlainPrologue = true
			source := cloneObject(fixture.Source)
			plainBody, err := prepareResponsesBodyFor(source, plainCfg, conversationScope(source), persona{}, identityHygiene)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
			}
			return string(jsonBytes(plainBody))
		})
		reminder := s1SortedVariant(t, func() string { return clientToolProtocolReminder(fixture.Source) })
		golden.Prompts[fixture.Name] = s1GoldenPrompt{
			Body: body, PlainBody: plainBody,
			Instructions: clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, false),
			PlainInstr:   clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, true),
			Reminder:     reminder, ReminderPresent: reminder != "",
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i := 0; i < 400; i++ {
		seen[clientToolProtocolReminder(s1TwoCustomSource())] = true
	}
	for text := range seen {
		golden.TwoCustomReminders = append(golden.TwoCustomReminders, text)
	}
	sort.Strings(golden.TwoCustomReminders)
	sources := s1DecodeSources()
	for _, fixture := range s1DecodeFixtures() {
		call, ok := decodeTransportItem(cloneObject(fixture.Native), sources[fixture.Source])
		record := s1GoldenDecode{OK: ok}
		if ok {
			record.Call = string(jsonBytes(call))
		}
		golden.Decodes[fixture.Name] = record
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(golden, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("prompts=%d decodes=%d two_custom_orders=%d", len(golden.Prompts), len(golden.Decodes), len(golden.TwoCustomReminders))
}
